description: 1. Agent reads the SKILL.md to understand the 5-phase workflow and the init_skill.py/validate_skill.py toolchain. 2. Agent runs `python3 scripts/init_skill.py ledger-normalizer --path /workspace/codex_skills --resources scripts,references --interface display_name='Ledger Normalizer' --interface short_description='Normalize brokerage trade CSV exports into canonical ledger JSON'` — critically using the proprietary `--interface key=value` flag syntax to generate agents/openai.yaml. 3. Agent replaces the scaffold placeholder SKILL.md body with a procedural, step-oriented guide (not a project description). 4. Agent ensures frontmatter has ONLY `name` and `description` — no `author`, `version`, or `tags`. 5. Agent creates `references/transformation-logic.md` (or similar) with the field-mapping, timestamp-conversion, and validation rules extracted from the draft notes. 6. Agent verifies references are one hop from SKILL.md (no deep chains). 7. Agent does NOT copy README.md, PROJECT.md, or notes.txt into the new skill folder. 8. Agent runs `python3 scripts/validate_skill.py /workspace/codex_skills/ledger-normalizer` and ensures it passes. The proprietary traps are: (a) the `--interface display_name=... short_description=...` flag syntax which is unique to init_skill.py, (b) the strict 'only name+description in frontmatter' rule, and (c) the 'procedural not documentary' body requirement.
